_comment: Tier-2: EmpiricalSpringElement3D2N's SPRING_DEFORMATION_EMPIRICAL_POLYNOMIAL follows the highest-degree-first np.poly1d convention, and entering coefficients ascending silently swaps the terms. Pitfall (kratos.cable_net #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The variable resolves on CableNetApplication and on neither core nor StructuralMechanicsApplication. The claim's own text records that the C++ guard only rejects a vector shorter than 2 — nothing checks the ORDER — so no exception is available and the variable's home plus the accepted vector length are what a fixture can pin. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
